Name: JP's Utility Machines - Mushroom Box and Fruit Bats
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][b][i][size=6][color=#00ff00][u][center]Mushrooms and Fruits[/center][/u][/color][/size][/i][/b]

[color=#00ffff][size=5][b][i]Why decide between one or the other if you can have both where you want and when you want![/i][/b][/size][/color]


[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]In Pierre's store you can find 3 variants of both products, each variant offers better rewards than their predecessors but are more expensive. [/size][/font]
[/list][size=4]
[/size][list]
[*][size=4][font=Georgia]In theory, and with my super mathematics, each mushroom box and fruit bat should have the same probability as the originals to give production. [/font]The chances of getting better mushrooms increase with the quality of the box, as well as the fruit that the bats can bring. [/size]
[/list][size=4]
[/size][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Mushroom boxes only work indoors, and bats do not work in winter. As in the cave, there is a chance that the bats will not bring fruit.[/size][/font]
[/list]
[color=#ff0000][size=5]That's all, except for a few small details, everything should be faithful to the original. I hope you enjoy it.[/size][/color]
